o: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up.
